label: supercell
title: Supercell mesocyclone over the plains
hint: A flat horizon and a huge rotating base. The easiest case for the reconstruction and the best one to start with.

label: wall cloud
title: Wall cloud over prairie
hint: Dead-level horizon at mid frame, with grass close enough to the camera to show real relief.

label: shelf cloud
title: Shelf cloud over farmland (panorama)
hint: A stitched panorama, so it is unprojected onto a cylinder rather than a plane. Watch the Lens control pick that up on its own.

label: storm chase
title: NSSL chase vehicle beneath a wall cloud
hint: A large object a few metres from the camera. The best one for seeing the mesh tear at a silhouette instead of stretching.

label: marshland
title: Cumulonimbus over Klamath Basin
hint: Standing water in the foreground and a mountain skyline at the horizon, so the flash gets something to reflect off.
